I've been buying sourdough at my local Bakers Delight store for years. This year, a loaf eventually cost $7.20. I couldn't buy bread that expensive. I've since learnt, quite quickly actually, to bake my own sourdough at home for less than $2.00 a loaf, and it actually tastes a lot better than the Bakers Delight offering. I also get to experiment more with ingredients. I guess the question is why it has become so expensive to by a Bakers Delight loaf? It sure isn't rising cost of ingredients. A 12.5 kg bag of Victorian-made bakers flour costs me under $17.00, and that produces 25 loaves of great bread! The franchise has shot itself in the foot, I'm afraid.
